name: Missing Authorization on Critical State Mutation
description: Admin settings update endpoint checks authentication token but never verifies user role or admin privilege before modifying system configuration.

name: Cross-Tenant Data Leakage via Unscoped Identifier
description: Document fetch endpoint queries document strictly by documentId without enforcing session tenantId scope, enabling cross-tenant data exfiltration.

name: Confused Deputy via Credential-Forwarding Proxy
description: Internal service relay forwards ambient service-mesh credentials to arbitrary caller-specified destinations, acting as a confused deputy.

name: Broken State Machine Transition in Payment Workflow
description: Payment refund endpoint allows state transition directly from CREATED to REFUNDED without verifying prior PAID state.

name: Validated vs. Consumed Input Mismatch
description: Validation check inspects req.query.filePath for traversal, but file operations consume raw req.body.filePath, rendering the validation moot.

name: Partial Mitigation in Context-Dependent Sanitizer
description: Sanitizer escapes HTML attributes but output is embedded directly inside an unquoted inline script block, allowing execution.

name: Insecure Default Privilege Fallback
description: Security policy evaluation defaults to PERMISSIVE / ALLOW_ALL when configuration key is missing or undefined.

name: Multi-Step Taint Flow Across Asynchronous Job Boundary
description: Untrusted input arrives at webhook endpoint, enqueues to message broker, is dequeued by worker, and is executed without deserialization safeguards.

name: Prototype Pollution via Unsanitized Object Merge
description: Recursive object merge utility dynamically copies properties from untrusted input without filtering __proto__ or constructor, enabling prototype pollution.

name: TOCTOU Race Condition in Financial State Mutation
description: Withdrawal endpoint performs balance check prior to an asynchronous I/O operation and deducts balance afterwards without mutex locking, enabling TOCTOU double-spend.

name: Enforced Role Authorization Guard
description: Endpoint enforces role === admin verification check prior to executing configuration update.

name: Tenant-Scoped Document Query Guard
description: Document query explicitly filters by both id and currentTenantId.

name: Allowlisted Destination Relay Guard
description: Internal relay enforces strict URL allowlist and strips ambient credentials before forwarding.

name: State Machine Prerequisite Validation Guard
description: Fulfillment endpoint verifies order is in PAID state before transitioning to FULFILLED.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces prerequisite state machine guard invariant

name: Canonicalized Basename Guard
description: Target filename is strictly stripped to basename and confirmed within DATA_DIR boundary.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces directory jail and basename boundary

name: Context-Aware HTML Attribute Encoding Guard
description: Input is properly encoded for HTML attribute context and rendered inside a quoted input element rather than executable script.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces context-complete attribute encoding and HTML structure containment

name: Secure Default-Deny Policy Guard
description: Security policy evaluation defaults to DENY_ALL when unconfigured.

name: Allowlisted Command Dispatch Table Guard
description: Dispatched queue tasks are resolved via static dictionary dispatch table without dynamic code evaluation.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces static task lookup table rejecting arbitrary code evaluation

name: Key-Filtering Prototype Pollution Guard
description: Object merge recursively rejects __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys before property assignment.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces prototype key rejection invariant (__proto__, constructor, prototype)

name: Atomic Account Lock Concurrency Guard
description: Withdrawal transaction executes within an exclusive mutex lock to prevent concurrent TOCTOU race conditions.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces mutex serialization across check and state mutation
